summary: Phase 5 auth + claim end-to-end testing. Backend pytest 14/14 pass (test_auth 5/5, test_saves 9/9). Frontend: anonymous play works with no login wall (Landing -> character creation -> Chapter 1 choice -> cloud save synced). Sync chip reflects real state ('Local save' -> 'Saved to cloud' -> 'Offline - saved locally' with /api blocked). AccountBar shows Sign in when unauthenticated and Sign out when a seeded session_token cookie (httpOnly/secure/sameSite=None) is injected; /api/auth/me resolves user via cookie; logout returns to signed-out state. Claim flow: anonymous progress persisted to /api/saves/{vc_id}; after injecting a fresh user's session cookie and reloading, the account save adopted the anonymous playerState (name=ClaimTest, coins=250, scene=b1_c1_s2a, rev=1). Device B (fresh browser context, same user cookie, no localStorage) loaded the app and adopted the account save (Landing shows 'Continue Story' with 'ClaimTest - Chapter 1'). No regressions in gothic design; account bar / sync chip are small and unobtrusive.
critical_code_review_comments: Pre-existing benign console noise: initial GET /api/auth/me returns 401 for anonymous users and GET /api/saves/{new_id} returns 404 on first load, both surface as 'Failed to load resource' warnings. cloudClient handles these gracefully; consider suppressing via non-throwing fetch paths for polish, non-blocking.
test_credentials: Seeded ephemeral sessions in mongo db 'vampires_choice' per /app/auth_testing.md; used both Bearer tokens (API) and injected httpOnly session_token cookies (browser). All test users (email prefix test.user.) and test_session_* rows deleted at end of run.
seed_data_creation: Seeded 3 users + sessions during run (auth-me test, claim test A, claim test B). Deleted post-test via cleanup mongosh script. Ephemeral anonymous cloud_saves docs remain (vc_* ids) - harmless.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Public URL: https://84917d5f-bab4-4eda-8134-1d87293b0dc7.preview.emergentagent.com. Backend runs on :8001, same-origin /api. Backend regression: `pytest backend/tests/ -v` (14/14). Auth testing playbook: seed session directly in mongo (db=vampires_choice), then inject cookie {name:'session_token',domain:<host>,httpOnly:true,secure:true,sameSite:'None'} for browser or use as Bearer for API. AuthContext handles session_id URL hash on load; OAuth redirect is not exercised in automation (documented test path uses cookie injection). Use element.click() via page.evaluate to bypass achievement banner overlay that intercepts coordinate clicks. Data-testids verified present: account-login-btn, account-logout-btn, sync-status-chip, claim-conflict-modal, conflict-use-cloud-btn, conflict-use-local-btn.
